title: Order identifier (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 1 demos. Preserve source value; external reference matching requires evidence.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core order; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. A physical schema role is retained, but a single broad demand label does not define a reusable common meaning. Distinguish entity, identifier, display name, descriptive value and computed aggregate. A field implementation needs a precise concept and reviewed binding role; source strings and value samples alone do not establish external equivalence.
